messages:
j.doe (Acme): Hey team — our A/B rollout dashboard is showing variant cohorts flipped for experiment exp_2026_checkout. UI shows Variant A = 72%, Variant B = 28% but our server-side logs show the reverse. This is affecting billing and funnel metrics. Can someone look?

anna.support: sorry you're hitting this, @j.doe. Can you share a screenshot and an example user id that should be in B? :sad_face:

j.doe (Acme): Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/exp_checkout_mismatch.png. Example user: user_78942 — server logs indicate assignment: variant=B, timestamp=2026-03-15T09:21:02Z.

ingest-bot: Pipeline alert: events-ingest lag spike detected 2026-03-15T09:20:30Z → 00:07 latency. Backfill job running.

jay.eng: Thanks @j.doe — tagging in. Quick hypothesis: label mapping in the rollout dashboard may be using cohort_id -> label join that's off by one after a recent migration. Can you dump a few rows from the assignments ledger?

libby.data: Pasting a trimmed query I ran against prod assignments: ```sql
SELECT user_id, cohort_id, variant_label, assigned_at FROM assignments_ledger WHERE experiment_id='exp_2026_checkout' AND user_id IN ('user_78942','user_52233') ORDER BY assigned_at DESC LIMIT 10;
``` Result (sanitized):
- user_78942, cohort_id=17, variant_label='B', assigned_at=2026-03-15T09:21:02Z
- user_52233, cohort_id=16, variant_label='A', assigned_at=2026-03-15T09:20:58Z

libby.data: But the dashboard query is joining cohort_id -> variant_label using the cohorts table that was modified in a deploy earlier today. I see cohort_id 16/17 labels look swapped in latest cohorts snapshot.

maya.pm: We rolled a cohorts meta migration at 09:15 for consistent naming (PR #4567). @jay any chance that migration used the wrong sort order?

jay.eng: That matches my local repro. The migration script did a window() over ordered created_at but the export had a different ordering, so labels shifted by offset of 1 for that experiment's cohort namespace. Looks like cohort_id numeric values are correct but the label column mapping is shifted.

anna.support: Can we confirm impact surface? Are historical dashboards corrupted or just the live A/B dashboard?

libby.data: Quick impact check: metrics ingestion uses cohort_id for aggregation (correct). The UI layer resolves cohort_id->label for display. So aggregation numbers (counts) are correct, but the UI labels are mapped wrong causing the appearance of swapped variants and incorrect assignment counts per label. So the underlying counts for cohort 16 vs 17 are unchanged.

j.doe (Acme): OK that helps — so our actual experiment results are fine? We just need labels fixed ASAP because customers see wrong traffic split on the console.

jay.eng: Plan: 1) hotfix the cohorts table mapping by rolling back the bad migration snapshot and re-applying with stable ordering (ETA 30m). 2) patch the dashboard UI to preferentially display variant keys (stable) not labels where possible. 3) add a sanity check in the onboarding to detect label/cohort offset for future deploys.

anna.support: I'll inform affected customers that we identified a labeling bug and working on a fix. Draft message: "We've found a labeling mismatch in the A/B dashboard that affects display only — your experiment assignments and metrics are intact; visible labels may be incorrect. We're deploying a fix and will update when complete." Thoughts?

maya.pm: LGTM, add note about ETA (approx 30–45 mins) and that no data reprocessing is required.

libby.data: I'm running a verification query post-fix to diff counts by cohort_id vs label mapping: ```sql
SELECT cohort_id, SUM(1) as users FROM assignments_ledger WHERE experiment_id='exp_2026_checkout' GROUP BY cohort_id ORDER BY cohort_id;
-- then compare to UI-label aggregated counts once fix is live
```

jay.eng: Deploying rollback patch to cohorts metadata now (rolling 3 nodes). Will post logs.

ingest-bot: Backfill job completed at 2026-03-15T09:28:49Z. 0 failures.

jay.eng: Patch applied on node-1/2/3. Confirming DB snapshot restored and migration re-run with explicit ORDER BY created_at,cohort_key.

libby.data: Re-ran diffs. Before patch: label "A" showed 7,200 users; label "B" 2,800. After patch: cohort_id=16 -> 2,800 users, cohort_id=17 -> 7,200 users. UI now reflects correct mapping.

anna.support: Fix deployed. Notifying customers now. @j.doe want me to send the message?

j.doe (Acme): Yes please, thanks. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

maya.pm: Follow-ups: add a pre-deploy test to verify cohort_id->label mapping for any migration touching cohorts table; raise a postmortem for the migration change.

jay.eng: Filing a short postmortem and PR to add the test. I'll include the rollback commands and the verification queries.

anna.support: Customer message sent. Closing thread after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
